name: 26. Anthropic Native Server-Side Fallback (fallbacks shape overload)
description:
Pins the overloaded request-level `fallbacks` wire key on /anthropic/v1/messages.
Two unrelated features share the key and are disambiguated by element shape:
  - array of STRINGS  ("provider/model") = Bifrost cross-provider gateway fallback.
  - array of OBJECTS  ([{"model": "..."}]) = Anthropic native server-side fallback
    (beta server-side-fallback-2026-06-01, refusal fallback).

Regressions pinned:
  1. Object-form fallbacks used to fail Bifrost-side unmarshalling with 'Invalid JSON'
     because AnthropicMessageRequest.Fallbacks was typed []string. It is now a shape
     tolerant union, so both forms parse.
  2. Native (object) fallbacks are Anthropic-only. Forwarding them to Vertex, Bedrock,
     Bedrock Mantle or Azure produced a live 400 'fallbacks: Extra inputs are not
     permitted', because AddMissingBetaHeadersToContext correctly withholds the beta
     header there while the field was still forwarded. Bifrost now strips native
     entries fail-closed for providers whose ProviderFeatures.ServerSideFallback is
     false. Note bedrock_mantle is NOT supported: it is Bedrock's native Anthropic
     surface, but feature availability still follows Amazon Bedrock.
  3. Bifrost string-form fallbacks must keep working and must never leak to a provider.

Both the Claude Code passthrough path (claude-cli User-Agent -> raw request body) and
the normalized path are covered, since the strip runs on the shared egress tail.

Not covered here: the `fallback` content block and stop_reason 'refusal'. Those only
occur when a safety classifier actually declines a request, which is non-deterministic
and inappropriate to provoke in a live sweep; they are covered by Go unit tests in
core/providers/anthropic/serversidefallback_test.go.

Every row sends x-bf-send-back-raw-request and reads the request Bifrost sent: rows 1, 3, 4 and 5 carry no fallbacks field (row 2's Claude Code passthrough returns no raw_request), row 6 carries the object array as sent, and row 5 also shows the string form consumed by the gateway, which serves its string entry as Bifrost's own fallback when the primary model does not exist.

item.name: vertex/claude-opus-4-7 · native object fallbacks stripped for unsupported provider

exec: // Infra noise (auth / rate limit / upstream 5xx) skips so it does not false-fail.
// 400 is deliberately NOT guarded here - a 400 IS the regression signature for this folder.
var raw = pm.response.text() || '';
pm.test('vertex/claude-opus-4-7: native fallbacks parsed and stripped, no provider rejection', function () {
// Original report: object-form fallbacks failed to unmarshal into []string -> 'Invalid JSON'.
pm.expect(raw.toLowerCase().indexOf('invalid json'), 'Bifrost failed to parse the fallbacks field: ' + raw).to.equal(-1);
// Live 400 signature when the field reaches a target that does not accept it.
pm.expect(raw.indexOf('Extra inputs are not permitted'), 'fallbacks reached a target that rejects it: ' + raw).to.equal(-1);
// The provider does not support server-side fallback, so Bifrost must strip the
// native entries before egress (the beta header is withheld there too).
pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'request failed: ' + raw).to.be.below(400);
var rawBody = {}; try { rawBody = pm.response.json() || {}; } catch (e) { rawBody = {}; }
var rr = (rawBody.extra_fields || {}).raw_request;
if (typeof rr === 'string') { try { rr = JSON.parse(rr); } catch (e) { rr = null; } }
pm.test('the request sent to the provider carries no fallbacks field', function () {
pm.expect(rr, 'raw_request missing or unparseable: ' + raw.slice(0, 300)).to.be.an('object');
pm.expect(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rr, 'fallbacks'), 'fallbacks reached the provider: ' + JSON.stringify(rr).slice(0, 400)).to.eql(false);

item.name: [SKIP] [NATIVE-PASSTHROUGH] anthropic/claude-opus-4-7 · Bifrost string fallbacks are not leaked to the provider

exec: // Infra noise (auth / rate limit / upstream 5xx) skips so it does not false-fail.
// 400 is deliberately NOT guarded here - a 400 IS the regression signature for this folder.
var raw = pm.response.text() || '';
pm.test('anthropic/claude-opus-4-7: Bifrost string fallbacks consumed by the gateway, not forwarded', function () {
// Original report: object-form fallbacks failed to unmarshal into []string -> 'Invalid JSON'.
pm.expect(raw.toLowerCase().indexOf('invalid json'), 'Bifrost failed to parse the fallbacks field: ' + raw).to.equal(-1);
// Live 400 signature when the field reaches a target that does not accept it.
pm.expect(raw.indexOf('Extra inputs are not permitted'), 'fallbacks reached a target that rejects it: ' + raw).to.equal(-1);
// String entries are Bifrost gateway failover targets; Anthropic never sees them.
pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'request failed: ' + raw).to.be.below(400);
var rawBody = {}; try { rawBody = pm.response.json() || {}; } catch (e) { rawBody = {}; }
var rr = (rawBody.extra_fields || {}).raw_request;
if (typeof rr === 'string') { try { rr = JSON.parse(rr); } catch (e) { rr = null; } }
pm.test('the request sent to Anthropic carries no fallbacks field', function () {
pm.expect(rr, 'raw_request missing or unparseable: ' + raw.slice(0, 300)).to.be.an('object');
pm.expect(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rr, 'fallbacks'), 'string fallbacks reached Anthropic: ' + JSON.stringify(rr).slice(0, 400)).to.eql(false);
// The gateway consumes the strings: with a primary model Anthropic does not have, the string entry serves as
// Bifrost's own fallback, and its request carries no fallbacks either.

pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.variables.get('baseUrl') + '/anthropic/v1/messages', method: 'POST', header: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'x-bf-send-back-raw-request': 'true' }, body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ model: 'anthropic/claude-harness-missing-model', max_tokens: 16, messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Hello' }], fallbacks: ['anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6'] }) } }, function (err, res) {
var t = res ? res.text() : String(err);
var j = {}; try { j = res.json() || {}; } catch (e) { j = {}; }
var rr2 = (j.extra_fields || {}).raw_request;
if (typeof rr2 === 'string') { try { rr2 = JSON.parse(rr2); } catch (e) { rr2 = null; } }
pm.test('the string fallback is the gateway\u2019s: a missing primary model is rescued by anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-6', function () {
pm.expect(res && res.code, t.slice(0, 400)).to.eql(200);
pm.expect(res.headers.get('x-bifrost-routing-info-is-fallback'), t.slice(0, 400)).to.eql('true');
pm.expect(res.headers.get('x-bifrost-routing-info-provider'), t.slice(0, 400)).to.eql('anthropic');
pm.expect(res.headers.get('x-bifrost-routing-info-model'), t.slice(0, 400)).to.eql('claude-sonnet-4-6');
pm.test('the fallback\u2019s request to Anthropic carries no fallbacks field either', function () {
pm.expect(rr2, 'raw_request missing: ' + t.slice(0, 300)).to.be.an('object');
pm.expect(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(rr2, 'fallbacks'), JSON.stringify(rr2).slice(0, 400)).to.eql(false);

item.name: [SKIP] [NATIVE-PASSTHROUGH] anthropic/claude-fable-5 · native object fallbacks forwarded with server-side-fallback beta

exec: // Infra noise (auth / rate limit / upstream 5xx) skips so it does not false-fail.
// 400 is deliberately NOT guarded here - a 400 IS the regression signature for this folder.
var raw = pm.response.text() || '';
pm.test('anthropic/claude-fable-5: native fallbacks accepted (beta header auto-injected)', function () {
// Original report: object-form fallbacks failed to unmarshal into []string -> 'Invalid JSON'.
pm.expect(raw.toLowerCase().indexOf('invalid json'), 'Bifrost failed to parse the fallbacks field: ' + raw).to.equal(-1);
// Live 400 signature when the field reaches a target that does not accept it.
pm.expect(raw.indexOf('Extra inputs are not permitted'), 'fallbacks reached a target that rejects it: ' + raw).to.equal(-1);
// Anthropic is the only provider with ServerSideFallback=true, so the field is
// forwarded and Bifrost auto-injects server-side-fallback-2026-06-01. A rejection
// of the field itself would mean the beta header was not injected.
pm.expect(pm.response.code, 'request failed: ' + raw).to.be.below(400);
var rawBody = {}; try { rawBody = pm.response.json() || {}; } catch (e) { rawBody = {}; }
var rr = (rawBody.extra_fields || {}).raw_request;
if (typeof rr === 'string') { try { rr = JSON.parse(rr); } catch (e) { rr = null; } }
pm.test('the request sent to Anthropic carries the object fallbacks as sent', function () {
pm.expect(rr, 'raw_request missing or unparseable: ' + raw.slice(0, 300)).to.be.an('object');
pm.expect(rr.fallbacks, 'object fallbacks were dropped before Anthropic: ' + JSON.stringify(rr).slice(0, 400)).to.eql([{ model: 'claude-opus-4-8' }]);
